fusions.name: Ponderous Push
fusions.desc: Sends a slow wave that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lulling Tide
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes a wave that deals 6 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gentle Audience
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Steady Reign
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
